podcast.title: Crossover Successes
podcast.body: Over recent years, several Christian alternative rock bands have achieved unexpected mainstream success, including Creed, P.O.D., Collector Soul, Evanescence, Chevelle, MXPX, and At The Drive-In. "And over the last couple of years, we've seen a number of bands crossover and become unexpected successes."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Growing Area of Popular Music
podcast.body: This genre is highlighted as a very large and expanding area within popular music, garnering significant attention from fans. "They quite rightly point out that this is one area of popular music that's very big and getting bigger."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Limited Appeal Perception
podcast.body: Despite its growth, the genre is often perceived by the mainstream music industry as having "built-in, limited appeal" due to its religious connotations. "But because of the scene's religious connotations, it's considered to have built-in, limited appeal."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Mainstream Industry Misunderstanding
podcast.body: The mainstream music industry often struggles to understand how to handle these bands and their values, being more accustomed to promoting themes of rebellion, sex, and violence rather than "God business." "Most of the mainstream music industry doesn't know what to do with these bands and their values."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
